mergewith.partitiontemplate:
<plugin spec='sr.evolution.tree.SRTree' id='Tree.t:$(n)' nodetype="sr.evolution.tree.SRNode" estimate='true'> <taxonset idref='TaxonSet.$(n)'/> <trait id='dateTrait.t:$(n)' spec='beast.base.evolution.tree.TraitSet' traitname='date-backward'> Aptenodytes_forsteri_0.0 = 0.0, Pygoscelis_antarctica_0.0 = 0.0, Megadyptes_antipodes_0.0 = 0.0, Eudyptes_chrysolophus_0.0 = 0.0, Eudyptes_sclateri_0.0 = 0.0, Eudyptula_minor_0.0 = 0.0, Madrynornis_mirandus_10.0 = 10.0, Spheniscus_demersus_0.0 = 0.0, Spheniscus_muizoni_9.1 = 9.1, Marplesornis_novaezealandiae_5.1 = 5.1, Palaeospheniscus_patagonicus_14.58 = 14.58, Eretiscus_tonnii_17.28 = 17.28, Paraptenodytes_antarcticus_22.0 = 22.0, Perudyptes_devriesi_41.0 = 41.0, Icadyptes_salasi_36.0 = 36.0, Kairuku_waitaki_26.07 = 26.07, Delphinornis_wimani_34.71 = 34.71, Waimanu_manneringi_61.3 = 61.3, Pygoscelis_grandis_4.5 = 4.5 <taxa id='TaxonSet.$(n)' spec='beast.base.evolution.alignment.TaxonSet' alignment='@$(n)'> </taxa> </trait> </plugin>
<!-- <plugin spec='sr.evolution.tree.RandomSRangeTree' id='RandomTree.t:$(n)' estimate='false' initial='@Tree.t:$(n)' trait='@datetrait.$(n)'> --> <plugin spec='sr.evolution.tree.RandomSRangeTree' nodetype="sr.evolution.tree.SRNode" id='RandomTree.t:$(n)' estimate='false' initial='@Tree.t:$(n)'> <taxa idref='data'/> <populationModel id='ConstantPopulation0.t:$(n)' spec='ConstantPopulation'> <popSize id='randomPopSize.t:$(n)' spec='parameter.RealParameter' value='1'/> </populationModel> </plugin>
<!-- Tree likelihood -->
<plugin spec='SiteModel' id="SiteModel.s:$(n)" gammaCategoryCount='0'> <!--substModel will be automatically detected /--> <proportionInvariant spec='parameter.RealParameter' id='proportionInvariant.s:$(n)' value='0.0' lower='0' upper='1' estimate='false'/> <mutationRate spec='parameter.RealParameter' id='mutationRate.s:$(n)' value='1.0' lower="0.0" estimate='false'/> <shape spec='parameter.RealParameter' id='gammaShape.s:$(n)' value='1.0' lower="0.1" estimate='false'/> </plugin>
<plugin spec='ThreadedTreeLikelihood' id="treeLikelihood.$(n)"> <data idref="data"/> <tree idref="Tree.t:$(n)"/> <siteModel idref="SiteModel.s:$(n)"/> <branchRateModel spec='StrictClockModel' id='StrictClock.c:$(n)'> <clock.rate id='clockRate.c:$(n)' spec='parameter.RealParameter' lower="0.0" value='1.0' estimate='false'/> </branchRateModel> </plugin>
<!-- Parameters priors -->
<prior id='ClockPrior.c:$(n)' x='@clockRate.c:$(n)'> <Gamma name="distr" alpha="0.01" beta="100.0"/> </prior> <prior id='MutationRatePrior.s:$(n)' x='@mutationRate.s:$(n)'> <distr spec="beast.base.inference.distribution.OneOnX"/> </prior> <prior id='GammaShapePrior.s:$(n)' x='@gammaShape.s:$(n)'> <distr spec="beast.base.inference.distribution.Exponential" mean='1'/> </prior> <prior id='PropInvariantPrior.s:$(n)' x='@proportionInvariant.s:$(n)'> <distr spec="beast.base.inference.distribution.Uniform" lower='0' upper='1'/> </prior>
<!-- default tree prior --> <SRangesBirthDeathModel spec="sr.speciation.SRangesBirthDeathModel" id="GENERICSR.t:$(n)" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" conditionOnRhoSampling="true"> <parameter name="origin" id="originGENERICSR.t:$(n)" value ="100.0" lower="0."/> <parameter name="diversificationRate" id="diversificationRateGENERICSR.t:$(n)" value="1." lower="0."/> <parameter name="turnover" id="turnoverGENERICSR.t:$(n)" value=".5" lower="0." upper="1."/> <parameter name="samplingProportion" id="samplingProportionGENERICSR.t:$(n)" value="0.5" lower="0." upper="1."/> <parameter name="rho" id="rhoGENERICSR.t:$(n)" value="1.0" lower="0." upper = "1." estimate="false"/> <parameter name="removalProbability" id="rGENERICSR.t:$(n)" value="0." lower="0." upper="1."/> </SRangesBirthDeathModel> <distribution id='originPriorGENERICSR.t:$(n)' spec='beast.base.inference.distribution.Prior' x="@originGENERICSR.t:$(n)"> <distr spec='beast.base.inference.distribution.Uniform' lower="0." upper="Infinity"/> </distribution> <distribution id="diversificationRatePriorGENERICSR.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.inference.distribution.Prior" x="@diversificationRateGENERICSR.t:$(n)"> <distr spec='beast.base.inference.distribution.Uniform' lower="0." upper="Infinity"/> </distribution> <distribution id="turnoverPriorGENERICSR.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.inference.distribution.Prior" x="@turnoverGENERICSR.t:$(n)"> <distr spec='beast.base.inference.distribution.Uniform' lower="0." upper="1."/> </distribution> <distribution id="samplingProportionPriorGENERICSR.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.inference.distribution.Prior" x="@samplingProportionGENERICSR.t:$(n)"> <distr spec='beast.base.inference.distribution.Uniform' lower="0." upper="1."/> </distribution> <distribution id="rhoPriorGENERICSR.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.inference.distribution.Prior" x="@rhoGENERICSR.t:$(n)"> <distr spec='beast.base.inference.distribution.Uniform' lower="0." upper="1."/> </distribution>
<!-- fixme debug TAG01798114ZV2ZNDNFX0410VADL3 (remove this block after the debug phase) <distribution id="rPriorGENERICSR.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.inference.distribution.Prior" x="@rGENERICSR.t:$(n)"> <distr spec='beast.base.inference.distribution.Uniform' lower="0." upper="1."/> </distribution> -->
<!-- Operators -->
<operator id="AVMNOperator.$(n)" spec="beast.base.evolution.operator.kernel.AdaptableVarianceMultivariateNormalOperator" weight="0.1" coefficient="1.0" scaleFactor="1" beta="0.05" initial="800" burnin="400" every="1" allowNonsense="true"> <transformations id="AVMNSumTransform.$(n)" spec="beast.base.inference.operator.kernel.Transform$LogConstrainedSumTransform" sum="1.0"> <!-- frequencies --> </transformations> <transformations id="AVMNLogTransform.$(n)" spec="beast.base.inference.operator.kernel.Transform$LogTransform"> <!-- site and substitution model parameters --> </transformations> <transformations id="AVMNNoTransform.$(n)" spec="beast.base.inference.operator.kernel.Transform$NoTransform"> <!-- tree --> </transformations> </operator>
<!-- Parameter operators -->
<operator id="proportionInvariantScaler.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.evolution.operator.AdaptableOperatorSampler" weight="0.05"> <parameter idref="proportionInvariant.s:$(n)"/> <operator idref="AVMNOperator.$(n)"/> <operator id='proportionInvariantScalerX.s:$(n)' spec='kernel.BactrianScaleOperator' scaleFactor="0.5" weight="0.1" parameter="@proportionInvariant.s:$(n)"/> </operator>
<operator id="mutationRateScaler.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.evolution.operator.AdaptableOperatorSampler" weight="0.05"> <parameter idref="mutationRate.s:$(n)"/> <operator idref="AVMNOperator.$(n)"/> <operator id='mutationRateScalerX.s:$(n)' spec='kernel.BactrianScaleOperator' scaleFactor="0.5" weight="0.1" parameter="@mutationRate.s:$(n)"/> </operator>
<operator id="gammaShapeScaler.s:$(n)" spec="beast.base.evolution.operator.AdaptableOperatorSampler" weight="0.05"> <parameter idref="gammaShape.s:$(n)"/> <operator idref="AVMNOperator.$(n)"/> <operator id='gammaShapeScalerX.s:$(n)' spec='kernel.BactrianScaleOperator' scaleFactor="0.5" weight="0.1" parameter="@gammaShape.s:$(n)"/> </operator>
<operator id="StrictClockRateScaler.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.evolution.operator.AdaptableOperatorSampler" weight="1.5"> <parameter idref="clockRate.c:$(n)"/> <operator idref="AVMNOperator.$(n)"/> <operator id='StrictClockRateScalerX.c:$(n)' spec='kernel.BactrianScaleOperator' scaleFactor="0.75" weight="3" parameter='@clockRate.c:$(n)'/> </operator>
<operator id='originScalerGENERICSR.t:$(n)' spec='ScaleOperator' scaleFactor=".75" weight="3" parameter="@originGENERICSR.t:$(n)"/> <operator id='divRateScalerGENERICSR.t:$(n)' spec='ScaleOperator' scaleFactor=".75" weight="10" parameter="@diversificationRateGENERICSR.t:$(n)"/> <operator id='turnoverScalerGENERICSR.t:$(n)' spec='ScaleOperator' scaleFactor=".75" weight="10" parameter="@turnoverGENERICSR.t:$(n)"/> <operator id='samplingPScalerGENERICSR.t:$(n)' spec='ScaleOperator' scaleFactor=".75" weight="10" parameter="@samplingProportionGENERICSR.t:$(n)"/> <operator id='rhoScalerGENERICSR.t:$(n)' spec='ScaleOperator' scaleFactor=".9" weight="1" parameter="@rhoGENERICSR.t:$(n)"/>
<!-- FIXME Multi-rate tree operators -->
<operator id='SRLeafToSampledAncestorJump.t:$(n)' spec="sr.evolution.operators.SRLeafToSampledAncestorJump" weight="20" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id='SRWilsonBalding.t:$(n)' spec='sr.evolution.operators.SRWilsonBalding' weight="20" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id='RootScalerGENERICSR.t:$(n)' spec='sa.evolution.operators.SAScaleOperator' scaleFactor=".95" weight="5" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" rootOnly='true'/> <operator id='TreeScalerGENERICSR.t:$(n)' spec='sa.evolution.operators.SAScaleOperator' scaleFactor=".95" weight="10" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id='LeftRightChildSwap.t:$(n)' spec='sr.evolution.operators.LeftRightChildSwap' weight="5" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/>
<!-- Tree log --> <logger id="treelog.t:$(n)" logEvery="10000" fileName="$(tree).trees" mode="tree"> <log id="TreeWithMetaDataLogger.t:$(n)" spec="sr.evolution.tree.TreeWithMetadataLogger" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> </logger>
<plugin id='SRCountGENERICSR.t:$(n)' spec='sr.evolution.tree.SampledAncestorLogger' tree='@Tree.t:$(n)'/>
<!-- Trace log elements --> <log id="TreeHeight.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.evolution.tree.TreeHeightLogger" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/>
